operation.hypothesis: A local VLM with a fixed defect JSON rubric and min_confidence 0.7 can surface at least one white_balance/flare positive in the existing train pool; because only 4 samples are permitted, this cannot make white_balance measurable against MIN_CLASS_SUPPORT=5 - the only valid outcome is an agreement/calibration probe to decide whether a larger targeted weak-label batch is worth requesting later. Labels are weak only and never treated as ground truth.

params.rubric: fixed defect JSON: {blur,over_exp,under_exp,flare,white_balance} each {present:0|1, severity:0-3, direction:cool|warm|green|magenta for white_balance}
params.usage: train-only auxiliary supervision; never used as test truth

prompt:
你是图像质量标注员，只做判断、不解释。对给定图片判断下列五类缺陷是否存在，并给出严重度：blur(模糊)、over_exp(过曝)、under_exp(欠曝)、flare(炫光/光晕)、white_balance(白平衡异常，含 cool 偏冷/warm 偏暖/green 偏绿/magenta 偏品红)。
severity：0=无、1=轻、2=中、3=重；present 与 severity>0 必须一致。
严格只输出一行 JSON，不要 markdown 代码块，不要多余文字：
{"defects":{"blur":{"present":0,"severity":0},"over_exp":{"present":0,"severity":0},"under_exp":{"present":0,"severity":0},"flare":{"present":0,"severity":0},"white_balance":{"present":0,"severity":0,"direction":"none"}},"quality_score_0_100":0,"confidence_0_1":0.0}
